projects.label: Mangrove
projects.title: MAPS: Mangrove Analytics & Prediction System
projects.description: A web platform that predicts mangrove survivability and population growth, helping planters and coastal communities see how many of their mangroves will thrive over time, and plan reforestation with real numbers.

projects.label: RSCI
